About

I build AI agents that reason with real-world data, from grounded conversational assistants to autonomous analytics systems that verify every assumption before they speak.

My foundation is 14+ years in Human Resources at Radisson Blu Dhaka Water Garden, where I learned that high-stakes decisions need evidence, not intuition. I apply the same rigor to engineering intelligent systems.

Today I am an AI Engineering Fellow at the Google Cloud Gen AI Academy, APAC Edition (Cohort 3), and an AI/ML Engineer at TR Enterprise, Bangladesh. I have built and deployed five AI applications on Google Cloud Run. I also built multi-tool LangChain agents and completed an AI internship at CodeAlpha.

My focus: agentic architecture, LLM tool orchestration, RAG and cloud-native ML deployment: AI grounded in data, transparent in reasoning and useful for real decisions. If you are building AI systems that demand evidence before answers, I would welcome the conversation.
